correctness.rationale: Any EOP in a path square has components of one edge or two-edge stars only; triangle and middle-third-edge obstructions exclude larger connected components. Endpoint index separation yields four exact tile types with two unused vertices between components. Prefix/suffix and internal-gap summation proves the rational bivariate generating function; stars-and-bars proves the coefficient formula. Minimum vertex budget 3k-2 for even k and 3k-1 for odd k proves the six-residue optimum, and bounded-slack coefficient extraction proves exact maxima counts. Direct full-subset testing n=0..11 and separate formulas n=0..50 agree. Finite tests are supplementary, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Path squares form the first triangle-rich proper-interval family beyond paths. The new exact all-cardinality EOP polynomial simultaneously counts admissible interference-free edge sets, determines the optimal number of simultaneous transmissions, and counts every optimizer, with a nontrivial six-residue profile. These enumerative outputs are not obtained by known scalar EOP or injective-color-index bounds and are useful for solution-space sampling, availability at different requested capacities, and checking optimization implementations.
